title.narrative: Strengthening health systems for sustainable access to quality diagnosis, engagement of private sector, management of latent TB and amplifying community action for achieving TB elimination in India - India (01-Apr-2021-31-Mar-2024)

description.narrative: India, Tuberculosis, Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics India (FIND)This program has the following goals: To achieve a rapid decline in burden of TB, morbidity and mortality to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals of 80% reduction in incidence and 90% reduction in deaths by 2025; five years earlier than the stipulated timeline.. The objectives of this program are: To continue and complete implementation of AIC interventions at 100 Nodal DR-TB centres and to scale up AIC interventions at additional 85 DR-TB centres. To implement AIC interventions at 75 ART centres. To train and engage selected TB Champions to improve community awareness and preparedness for TB and COVID-19 through advanced communications skilling. To facilitate the formation and strengthening of local rapid response teams, led by TB Champions in coordination with local health officers and CHOs, to ensure that people with TB/COVID receive timely and appropriate services
